scope: Expanded feature-research completion requested after the bounded release. Preserve all original experiment identities and the observed holdout.

requirements.reason: Historical medians, interquartile ranges, upper-tail quantiles and skew cannot be recovered from the existing case-level means and extrema. Training-population peer quantiles do not test this family.
requirements.next_action: Build and screen a bounded raw-history distribution family on development data, then compare it with the fixed 700-feature control across all five folds.

requirements.reason: Source group indices are not verified event timestamps. Chronological trends require a field-level event/availability contract; unsupported histories must be excluded with a recorded reason.
requirements.next_action: Audit raw event-date semantics before admitting lag, trend or acceleration features; explicitly exclude histories whose ordering or availability cannot be established.

requirements.reason: Weeks 73-91 have already been observed. Repeated selection on the five development folds does not create new independent evidence.
requirements.next_action: Predeclare a nested temporal development study and require a new independent evaluation population before claiming a newly validated release.

justified_exclusions: Online target histories without outcome-availability timestamps; the release uses fold-fitted frequencies and the benchmark separately evaluated native CatBoost categorical statistics.
External joins without reproducible keys and competition permission.
Text, image or graph embeddings without a validated input modality.
